text: Artificial intelligence enables computers to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence.
Machine learning allows computers to learn patterns from data.
Deep learning is a branch of machine learning that uses neural networks.
Natural language processing helps computers understand human language.
Text embeddings represent sentences as numerical vectors.
Sentence transformers create meaningful vector representations of text.
Cosine similarity measures how similar two vectors are in direction.
Python is widely used for data science and artificial intelligence.
A neural network contains connected layers of artificial neurons.
Data cleaning improves the quality of machine learning datasets.
Students use notebooks to run Python code and record observations.
A database stores information in an organized way.
Renewable energy sources include solar power and wind power.
Plants need sunlight, water, and nutrients to grow.
The Earth revolves around the Sun once every year.
A healthy diet includes fruits, vegetables, and whole grains.
Football is a team sport played by two teams.
Online shopping allows customers to purchase products on the internet.
Cybersecurity protects computers, networks, and data from digital attacks.
Cloud computing provides computing services over the internet.
